facts.text: The decision under review is the authority's grant of building consent BC340112 under section 72 for a new dwelling on slippage-prone land.
The authority issued building consent BC340112 on 20 November 2024.
The 804 m2 site drops towards a gully, with a Building Restriction Line (BRL) recorded on the title from subdivision.
The property slopes down at a gradient of between 5° and 15° towards the crest, then at about 30° to the gully below.
Figure 3 shows site stability analysis from the owner's geotechnical engineer; Figure 2 shows the site plan with contours and the BRL.
